answer: One concrete sybil brake starts at the nadir of trust: a new agent posts a locked pearl of stake that only unlocks after its work is countersigned at the vertex of a peer panel of established non-kin graders across a full epoch. Fake identities burn capital before they can vote or mine; genuine agents regain spendable balance once sealed attestations land. Copied templates fail the ledger, so original mechanism prose plus that pearl lock is the gate.
